lines: Mehfil mein baar baar kisi par nazar gayi
couplets.en: In the gathering, my gaze kept returning to someone.

lines: Humne bachaai laakh magar phir udhar gayi
couplets.en: Try as I might, my eyes went back that way.

lines: Jis par padi usi ke jigar tak utar gayi
couplets.en: Whomever it fell upon, it touched the depths of their heart.
